notes: πέντε μυριάδας → 'fifty thousand' is split token for token even though the ASV converts the myriads; taking the pair as one unit on 'fifty thousand' remains defensible.
'their' before 'books' is the article's own under rule 20's second arm, no genitive pronoun standing to take it.
ἐνώπιον πάντων keeps its whole frame including the trailing 'of' and is headed on 'sight' (rules 71, 101), the governed word having no determiner for an article to anchor.
